title: Presenting: The Craft of Being with Guest Alek Lev

sentences.en: Welcome again to another bonus episode of How We Made Your Mother.
sentences.zh: 欢迎再次收看《我们是如何制作〈老爸老妈浪漫史〉的》另一期加更节目。

sentences.en: It's our final bonus episode before we launch season two towards the end of October.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在十月下旬推出第二季之前的最后一期加更节目。

sentences.en: In this upcoming season, we've already got a bunch of special guests lined up
sentences.zh: 在即将到来的第二季中，我们已经安排了一批特别嘉宾

sentences.en: and a very special announcement about our podcast,
sentences.zh: 以及关于我们播客的一个非常特别的公告，

sentences.en: which I'm just not quite allowed to announce right now.
sentences.zh: 只是我现在还不能马上宣布。

sentences.en: So stay tuned to the internet.
sentences.zh: 所以请大家随时关注网络上的消息。

sentences.en: This week, we bring you an interview that I did on the new podcast,
sentences.zh: 本周，我们为大家带来我接受新播客采访的内容，

sentences.en: The Craft of Being, hosted by Anna Schumacher.
sentences.zh: 这个播客叫《创作的本质》，由安娜·舒马赫主持。

sentences.en: The Craft of Being is a podcast via a series of conversations
sentences.zh: 《创作的本质》是一个通过一系列对话展开的播客，

sentences.en: where Anna digs into the question, what the heck even is creativity?
sentences.zh: 安娜在其中深入探讨了一个问题：到底什么是狗屁的创造力？

sentences.en: I got a chance to talk to her about producing the podcast and working with Josh and Craig,
sentences.zh: 我有机会与她聊了聊制作播客以及与乔什和克雷格合作的经历，

sentences.en: and then we go into other projects I've been involved with throughout the years.
sentences.zh: 然后我们还谈到了我多年来参与过的一些其他项目。

sentences.en: You can listen to The Craft of Being wherever you get your podcasts,
sentences.zh: 你可以在任何你获取播客的平台上收听《创作的本质》，

sentences.en: and there's even a link in our show notes.
sentences.zh: 并且我们的节目简介里也有链接。

sentences.en: Also, fun fact, Anna's voice can be heard in the opening montage of Hymnum fan voices
sentences.zh: 另外，趣事分享，在《我们是如何制作〈老爸老妈浪漫史〉》的第一集里，

sentences.en: in the very first episode of How We Made Your Mother.
sentences.zh: 开场粉丝呼声剪辑中就能听到安娜的声音。

sentences.en: And now, The Craft of Being.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们进入《创作的本质》。

sentences.en: Hi, hello, and welcome to another episode of The Craft of Being.
sentences.zh: 嗨，大家好，欢迎收看另一期《创作的本质》。

sentences.en: This is a podcast by way of a series of candid conversations
sentences.zh: 这是一个通过一系列坦诚对话展开的播客，

sentences.en: where we dig into what the heck even is creativity?
sentences.zh: 我们在其中深入探讨到底什么是狗屁的创造力？

sentences.en: Undefined yet definitive.
sentences.zh: 既未被定义却又十分明确。

sentences.en: We will talk about the types of innate creative muscles
sentences.zh: 我们将探讨那些与生俱来的创造力肌肉，

sentences.en: that live within all of us, within you.
sentences.zh: 它们存在于我们所有人心中，存在于你心中。

sentences.en: Yes, you.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是你。

sentences.en: And we will talk about how these creative muscles evolve with us
sentences.zh: 我们还将探讨这些创造力肌肉如何在生活中与我们共同进化，

sentences.en: across life, work, art, and the pursuit of everything.
sentences.zh: 贯穿生活、工作、艺术以及对万物的追求。

sentences.en: Today, we're going to chat about film and podcast media.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将聊聊电影和播客媒体。

sentences.en: My guest today is well-versed in both.
sentences.zh: 我今天的嘉宾对这两者都非常精通。

sentences.en: He wears many hats, and our conversation takes us through the systems
sentences.zh: 他身兼多职，我们的对话将探讨那些

sentences.en: that support and interact with the artistry.
sentences.zh: 支持并与艺术创作相互作用的体系。

sentences.en: Across the board, there's this kind of double consciousness
sentences.zh: 总体而言，在艺术创作走向世界的方式中，

sentences.en: in the way artistic creative work finds its way into the world.
sentences.zh: 存在着一种双重意识。

sentences.en: On one side, there's the intensity of the creative work itself,
sentences.zh: 一方面，是创作工作本身的强度，

sentences.en: the hours of writing, rehearsing, shooting, editing,
sentences.zh: 数小时的写作、排练、拍摄、剪辑，

sentences.en: stitching together details until they finally resolve into something coherent.
sentences.zh: 将细节拼凑在一起，直到它们最终融合成连贯的作品。

sentences.en: On the other side, there is the preparation,
sentences.zh: 另一方面，是准备工作，

sentences.en: the scaffolding of validation,
sentences.zh: 验证的框架，

sentences.en: the decks, the pitches, the budgets, the endless,
sentences.zh: 幻灯片提案、推介、预算、无休止的，

sentences.en: like me, trust me gestures, you'll hear Alec talk about that,
sentences.zh: 比如“相信我，信任我”的姿态，你们会听到亚历克谈到这一点，

sentences.en: that are required before many projects can even begin.
sentences.zh: 这些在许多项目甚至能够开始之前都是必需的。

sentences.en: And by begin, I mean here, begin with the goal of being seen,
sentences.zh: 我所说的开始，在这里是指带着这样的目标开始：被看到、

sentences.en: being picked up, becoming the thing that launches someone into a place
sentences.zh: 被选中、成为能够将某人推向这样一个地方的事物——

sentences.en: where the work can speak for itself,
sentences.zh: 在这个地方，作品可以不言自明，

sentences.en: and that someone can keep working in this stream,
sentences.zh: 且此人可以继续在这个领域工作，

sentences.en: so far as capitalism runs the game, okay?
sentences.zh: 只要资本主义还在掌控这个游戏，对吧？

sentences.en: Hollywood, capital H Hollywood,
sentences.zh: 好莱坞，大写的H好莱坞，

sentences.en: has built an empire on this double consciousness.
sentences.zh: 正是建立在这种双重意识的帝国之上。

sentences.en: It is a city where art and commerce are bound together so tightly
sentences.zh: 这是一个艺术与商业紧密交织在一起的城市，

sentences.en: that they appear inseparable,
sentences.zh: 以至于它们看起来密不可分，

sentences.en: where the beauty of a scene and the pressure of an opening weekend
sentences.zh: 在这里，一个场景的美感与首映周末的压力

sentences.en: are measured on the same ledger.
sentences.zh: 是在同一本账目上进行衡量的。

sentences.en: To speak about Hollywood is to speak about
sentences.zh: 谈论好莱坞，就是谈论

sentences.en: an entire architecture of creativity,
sentences.zh: 整个创意构架，

sentences.en: a system that provides opportunity and exposure,
sentences.zh: 一个提供机会与曝光的系统，

sentences.en: and also dictates form, funding, and legitimacy.
sentences.zh: 同时也决定了形式、资金与合法性。

sentences.en: A film is not simply the work of its director and caSt.
sentences.zh: 一部电影绝不仅仅是导演和演员的作品。

sentences.en: It's also the work of financiers, distributors,
sentences.zh: 它也是金融家、发行商、

sentences.en: marketing teams, and executives
sentences.zh: 营销团队以及高管的作品，

sentences.en: who determine whether the work will even see the light of day.
sentences.zh: 他们决定了这部作品能否见天日。

sentences.en: This structure is at once enabling and constraining.
sentences.zh: 这种结构既是赋能的，也是限制的。

sentences.en: It allows something as vast and complex as a feature film to even exist,
sentences.zh: 它让像故事片这样庞大复杂的作品得以存在，

sentences.en: but it also requires the artist to frame their own imagination
sentences.zh: 但它也要求艺术家构建自己的想象力，

sentences.en: in ways that appeal to some gatekeepers.
sentences.zh: 以迎合某些把关人。

sentences.en: The creative act begins long before a camera rolls, right?
sentences.zh: 创作行为在摄影机开拍前很久就已经开始了，对吧？

sentences.en: It begins in the translation of vision into the pitch deck,
sentences.zh: 它始于将愿景转化为推介文案，

sentences.en: into the log line,
sentences.zh: 转化为一句话梗概，

sentences.en: into a concise justification of why the work deserves to exiSt.
sentences.zh: 转化为对作品为何值得存在的简明论证。

sentences.en: The podcast world has inherited many of the same dynamics.
sentences.zh: 播客世界也继承了许多相同的动态。

sentences.en: Just like Tarantino once used to be able to make
sentences.zh: 就像昆汀曾经能够在仓库里

sentences.en: reservoir dogs in a warehouse on a whisper in a dream,
sentences.zh: 凭借一个梦想中的呢喃拍出《落水狗》一样，

sentences.en: so too can I sit here in our tiny spare room
sentences.zh: 我也能坐在这里，在我们那个小小的备用房间里，

sentences.en: that quadruples as bicycle storage and my desk in a dumping space
sentences.zh: 它兼作自行车库、我的办公桌以及

sentences.en: for outdoor gear and toddler toys
sentences.zh: 存放户外装备和幼儿玩具的杂物间，

sentences.en: and put my thoughts and craft out there,
sentences.zh: 把我的想法和手艺发布出去，

sentences.en: though I don't have Harvey Keitel,
sentences.zh: 虽然我没有哈威·凯特尔，

sentences.en: and thus it's just you and me.
sentences.zh: 因此这里只有你和我。

sentences.en: What might have once seemed like a freer medium,
sentences.zh: 曾经看似更自由的媒介——

sentences.en: just press record, let the conversation flow,
sentences.zh: 只需按下录音键，让对话自然流淌，

sentences.en: upload it for anyone to hear,
sentences.zh: 上传供任何人收听——

sentences.en: has quickly developed its own economies of scale,
sentences.zh: 迅速发展出了它自己的规模经济，

sentences.en: its own validation structures.
sentences.zh: 它自己的验证结构。

sentences.en: A podcast needs a host, yes,
sentences.zh: 一个播客需要主持人，没错，

sentences.en: but it also needs production schedules,
sentences.zh: 但它也需要制作日程、

sentences.en: advertising partnerships, distribution platforms,
sentences.zh: 广告合作、分发平台，

sentences.en: and metrics that prove value.
sentences.zh: 以及证明价值的数据指标。

sentences.en: Behind every hour of conversation released into the world
sentences.zh: 在向世界发布的每一小时对话背后，

sentences.en: are countless invisible acts of coordination,
sentences.zh: 都有无数看不见的协调工作，

sentences.en: emails, calendars, edits, sponsorship copies,
sentences.zh: 电子邮件、日程表、剪辑、赞助文案、

sentences.en: social media prompts.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体提示。

sentences.en: The work disappears into the final product,
sentences.zh: 这些工作融入了最终的产品中消失不见，

sentences.en: and yet it is essential to the very possibility of the show.
sentences.zh: 然而它却是节目得以存在的基础。

sentences.en: To be clear, I am all of the roles,
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我一个人包揽了所有角色，

sentences.en: and we do not have a sponsorship department.
sentences.zh: 而且我们没有赞助部门。

sentences.en: There is a paradox of much of modern artistic creativity.
sentences.zh: 现代艺术创作大多存在一个悖论。

sentences.en: The most ephemeral media often require
sentences.zh: 最短暂的媒介往往需要

sentences.en: the most relentless scaffolding.
sentences.zh: 最不间断的支撑框架。

sentences.en: Episodes vanish into a stream,
sentences.zh: 单集节目在信息流中消逝，

sentences.en: but the labor that sustains them is constant.
sentences.zh: 但维持它们的劳作确是持续不断的。

sentences.en: Movies may be remembered for decades,
sentences.zh: 电影可能会被铭记数十年，

sentences.en: but before they can exist,
sentences.zh: 但在它们能够存在之前，

sentences.en: they must pass through this obstacle course.
sentences.zh: 他们必须通过这道重重障碍。

sentences.en: In both cases, for film and podcasting,
sentences.zh: 无论是拍电影还是做播客，

sentences.en: the act of creation is inseparable
sentences.zh: 创作的行为始终密不可分，

sentences.en: from the structures that allow it to reach an audience.
sentences.zh: 与那些让作品得以触达受众的结构交织在一起。

sentences.en: There is something instructive
sentences.zh: 有一点很具有启示意义，

sentences.en: in noticing how creators move between these systeMs.
sentences.zh: 那就是观察创作者们如何在这些系统之间穿梭。

sentences.en: Directing a film and producing a podcast
sentences.zh: 导演一部电影和制作一档播客

sentences.en: may seem like entirely different crafts,
sentences.zh: 看起来像是完全不同的手艺，

sentences.en: yet they share a common rhythm.
sentences.zh: 然而它们却有着共同的节奏。

sentences.en: Establish the outline, the framework,
sentences.zh: 确立大纲、搭建框架，

sentences.en: set the stage, line up the ducks,
sentences.zh: 布置好场景，把一切准备就绪，

sentences.en: and then let the unpredictable alchemy of collaboration
sentences.zh: 然后任由合作中那不可预测的奇妙化学反应

sentences.en: bring something to life.
sentences.zh: 让某些生命力跃然呈现。

sentences.en: A director can block a scene,
sentences.zh: 导演可以走位排练一场戏，

sentences.en: but the actors will always bring their own nuance.
sentences.zh: 但演员们总能赋予其独特的细腻质感。

sentences.en: A producer can schedule the recording,
sentences.zh: 制作人可以安排好录制日程，

sentences.en: but the conversation will always unfold
sentences.zh: 但对话的展开方式

sentences.en: in ways that no outline can fully anticipate.
sentences.zh: 永远是任何大纲都无法完全预料的。

sentences.en: Creativity, as we've heard on many of these episodes,
sentences.zh: 正如我们在许多期节目中所听到的那样，创造力

sentences.en: so often thrives at the junction of order and play.
sentences.zh: 往往在秩序与自由玩味的交汇处蓬勃生长。

sentences.en: In today's conversation,
sentences.zh: 在今天的对话中，

sentences.en: we get into the way projects are set up.
sentences.zh: 我们深入探讨了项目筹备的方式。

sentences.en: Spreadsheets upon spreadsheets,
sentences.zh: 密密麻麻的电子表格，

sentences.en: sequences of scenes ordered and reordered,
sentences.zh: 一遍又一遍排序与重新排序的场景序列，

sentences.en: and then the joy of stepping back
sentences.zh: 然后是那种退后一步、欣喜地

sentences.en: to watch collaborators bring the unexpected.
sentences.zh: 看着合作伙伴带来意料之外惊喜的快乐。

sentences.en: And what emerges is the broader truth
sentences.zh: 而随之浮现的是关于

sentences.en: about film, television, podcasting, creativity itself,
sentences.zh: 电影、电视、播客以及创造力本身的更宏大真理，

sentences.en: that it oscillates between the structure and flow.
sentences.zh: 那就是它在结构与流动之间不断摇摆。

sentences.en: Too much order, the work becomes lifeless.
sentences.zh: 秩序太多，作品就会变得死气沉沉。

sentences.en: Too much freedom, the work risks incoherence.
sentences.zh: 自由太多，作品则面临语无伦次的风险。

sentences.en: This is not a lament.
sentences.zh: 这并非一种哀叹。

sentences.en: It is a recognition that modern creativity
sentences.zh: 这是一种认同，即现代的创造力

sentences.en: is always entangled with its systems
sentences.zh: 总是与它的分发和曝光系统

sentences.en: of distribution and visibility.
sentences.zh: 纠缠在一起。

sentences.en: To make something,
sentences.zh: 去创作某件作品，

sentences.en: it's also to navigate the infrastructures
sentences.zh: 同时也意味着去驾驭那些

sentences.en: that allow it to be seen, heard, or streamed, experienced.
sentences.zh: 让它得以被看见、被听到、被点播或被体验的基础设施。

sentences.en: You'll hear today that my guest, Alec,

sentences.en: reflects that this negotiation
sentences.zh: 反思说，这种博弈

sentences.en: is not a distraction from his creativity.
sentences.zh: 并非对创造力的干扰。

sentences.en: It is creativity.
sentences.zh: 这就是创造力本身。

sentences.en: To build a schedule that makes weekly episodes possible,
sentences.zh: 去制定一个让每周更新节目成为可能的时间表，

sentences.en: to reorder sequences in a screenplay
sentences.zh: 去重新调整剧本中的场景顺序

sentences.en: until they lock into place,

sentences.zh: 去协调你的合作伙伴。
